scope: Read-only descriptive audit of existing real ECB contexts; no prediction, fitting, learned tokenizer or source acquisition
corpus_status: Already acquired and explored revised 2026 snapshot, not a point-in-time or untouched test corpus
origins: At least 256 prices; origin date in split; target at horizon 20 remains in split; shared origins for all horizons

numeric_contract.scale: population standard deviation of the 64 increments ending at origin i, floor 1e-6
numeric_contract.x32: round x64 once to float32, common parent for C/Q/F/H
numeric_contract.bounds_failure: Stop before any model work; retain diagnostics and amend rather than clip or silently drop origins

descriptive_outputs_declared_before_exec: Per split/currency origin counts, repeated scalar input counts, unique underlying input dates
Ranges of x32, k and scales; scale-floor activation count
Number of numerical-bound breaches, nonfinite inputs, nonexact midpoint round trips and hierarchical decode failures
Escape counts and affected origin counts, for fixed vocabulary only
Distinct core flat and coarse codes; train-pooled core support for shared encoders
Development and pseudo-test core cells not seen in pooled training, and coarse components not seen; exposure and origin counts
Count of cells whose code would differ if quantized from x64 rather than the common x32
Maximum absolute x64-to-x32 rounding and x32-to-midpoint quantization errors
Date-only counts for B3 residual years 2005-2009, each horizon, respecting chronological label cutoffs

baseline_calendar.fit: For year y and horizon h, original train origins with h-target strictly before Jan 1 y
baseline_calendar.residual: Original train origins in year y with h-target remaining in year y
